# Primal Hunts

by VisionGLLast Updated: March 26, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Primal Hunts are random encounters, similar to the Nemesis mechanic. You discover them by activating Torn Rifts until you encounter a Mysterious Rift. Inside a Mysterious Rift, you hunt and slay the elusive Rift Beast. After you defeat the Rift Beast, you must spare one of its hatchlings, continuing the cycle. The hatchling you spare adds new traits to the Rift Beast's Lineage, making your next encounter more dangerous and influencing the rewards. Primal Hunts are one of the main ways to obtain Primordial Uniques and Runes of Evolution for crafting Primordial Exalted Items.

## Primal Hunt Mechanic Rewards

Primal Hunts
Interact with Torn and Mysterious Rifts and slay the monsters within to earn Primordial Materials. You can exchange these Primordial Materials with the Hunt Master, Skarven Bloodhorn, to purchase bags of loot containing common rewards such as crafting materials and Gold, Primordial Uniques, and Runes of Evolution.

The Primordial Materials include:

- Ancient Bones
- Primordial Fang
- Primordial Feather
- Primordial Horn
- Primordial Petal
- Crystallized Heart

### The Hunt Master

You can find Hunt Master Skarven Bloodhorn in The Garden in Chapter 10 and inside every Mysterious Rift you enter. Speaking with this NPC opens a Trade Window that displays bags of general loot, all purchaseable Primordial Uniques, and Runes of Evolution. You may purchase an item multiple times from the same Trade Window as long as you have the required Primordial Materials.

### General Rewards

The Hunt Master's inventory includes pouches of general loot that you can buy with Primordial Materials. The loot bags include:

- Bag of Uniques - Drops a random number of Unique items when opened.
- Bag of Glyphs - Drops a random amount of Glyphs when opened.
- Bag of Runes - Drops a random amount of Runes when opened.
- Bag of Gold - Drops a random amount of Gold when opened.
- Bag of Amber - Adds 5,000 Memory Amber to your Weaver Faction when opened. Can only be opened when you are a member of the Weaver Faction.
- Bag of Shards - Drops a random amount of Shards when opened.
- Bag of Primordial Materials - Drops a random combination of Primordial Horns, Fangs, Petals, and Feathers when opened. Occasionally, it also drops a Crystallized Heart.

### Primordial Uniques

You can purchase Primordial Uniques from the Hunt Master. His inventory always includes every purchasable Primordial Unique. Each Primordial Unique rolls for Legendary Potential when purchased.

Rift Beasts can also drop all Primordial Uniques. Their chance to drop Primordial Uniques scales with the number of active Evolutions they possess. The Primordial Materials that your specific Rift Beast drops can also influence the drop chance if those materials are part of the Primordial Unique's usual vendor cost. Corruption and Circle of Fortune Rank bonuses further affect the Primordial Unique drop rate.

### Rune of Evolution

The Hunt Master also sells the Rune of Evolution. This Rune is essential for crafting Primordial Exalted Items. It converts one Tier 7 Affix on an item into a Primordial Sealed Tier 8.

## Accessing Primal Hunts

Primal Hunts
You can first access Primal Hunts in the Campaign at Area Level 20. The process begins when you find a Mysterious Rift, which starts the encounter with your first Rift Beast and its Lineage. Afterward, you encounter several Torn Rifts until the next Mysterious Rift appears, continuing the process.

### Where to Find Mysterious and Torn Rifts

You can encounter Torn and Mysterious Rifts in both the Campaign and most Echoes. However, they do not appear in Quest Echoes and Arena Echoes. Torn and Mysterious Rifts never appear in the same Echo as a Tomb or Cemetery, since both count as side areas.

## Using the Primal Hunt Mechanic

Primal Hunts
Interacting with the Primal Hunt mechanic involves Evolving your Rift Beast along a Lineage within Mysterious Rifts. Between Mysterious Rift encounters, you fend off ambushes from Torn Rifts by your Rift Beast. Repeat this process to collect Primordial Materials and other drops specific to this mechanic, such as Evolution's End.

### Rift Beasts

Rift Beasts are Boss Enemies that gain traits and abilities as you encounter and Evolve them in Mysterious Rifts. These enemies provide Primordial Materials needed to trade with the Hunt Master NPC.

#### Evolutions

Each Rift Beast begins with two pre-existing Evolutions. When you encounter and slay the Rift Beast in a Mysterious Rift, you can choose from three Evolutions to add to its Lineage. Each Evolution adds powerful new abilities to your Rift Beast, along with general loot and specific Primordial Materials. When you select an Evolution, all Rift Beasts in that Lineage gain the associated traits until the Lineage ends.

When adding Evolutions to your Lineage, you cannot select the same Evolution more than once. There are over 60 Evolutions to choose from. By default, you can only Evolve a Lineage 4 times, in addition to the two pre-existing Evolutions your Rift Beast started with. After you complete all of the Evolutions, your Lineage resets. Completing two full Lineages and the Rampant Coast Woven Echo permanently increases this maximum to 9 Evolutions total per Lineage.

When you reach the maximum number of Evolutions in a Lineage, your only option is to end the Lineage after defeating the Rift Beast in a Mysterious Rift. Completing a Lineage this way drops an Evolution's End.

### Mysterious and Torn Rifts

Mysterious Rifts are the only way to Evolve and progress your Rift Beast Lineage. Each Mysterious Rift leads to a side area filled with Ancient Era enemies, where you track and slay your Rift Beast. After completing a Mysterious Rift, you must complete 2-4 Torn Rifts before you are able to encounter another.

Torn Rifts differ from Mysterious Rifts because they do not contain a side area. Instead, Torn Rifts spawn your Rift Beast, letting you fight it in your current area. Rift Beasts from Torn Rifts drop loot tied to your current Evolutions, along with general loot.

### Gathering Primordial Materials

Primordial Materials serve as currency to trade with the Hunt Master NPC. Ancient Bones are the most common Primordial Material, dropping from enemies in Mysterious Rifts instead of Gold. Other Primordial Materials correspond to different Evolution lines, shown at the bottom when choosing an Evolution. You can only obtain a Crystallized Heart by completing a Lineage.

## Woven Echoes and Weaver Tree Support

Primal Hunts
Three Woven Echoes are associated with Primal Hunts:

- Rampant Coast - This permanently unlocks an additional Evolution for your Rift Beast Lineages. It can also be farmed for Crystallized Hearts.
- Bloodline Glade - This Woven Echo is your primary way to farm items with Primordial Exalted Champion Affixes, which can't be turned into Primordial Exalted items naturally with Rune of Evolution.
- Nesting Grove - Completing this Woven Echo adds Rift Beast encounters to surrounding Echoes. This makes it helpful in preparing other Echoes to farm Primordial Materials.

Four Weaver Tree nodes also affect Primal Hunts:

- Age of Beasts - Rift Beasts are more common in your Echoes. (10% per Point, 3 Points Total)
- Riven Gateway - Rift Beasts that emerge from Rifts are accompanied by other enemies from the Ancient Era that drop Ancient Bones when slain. (1 Point Total)
- Crystal Growth - Rift Beasts have a higher chance to have Crystallized Hearts, and Rift Beasts with Crystallized Heart have more health and damage. (15% Crystallized Heart Chance, 15% More Health, 5% More Damage per Point, 3 Points Total)
- Primordial Ambush - You have a chance to be ambushed by randomly evolved Rift Beasts in your Echoes. These Rift Beasts have a slightly higher chance to drop Primordial Unique Items that cannot be purchased from Skarven Bloodhorn.

## Summary

Primal Hunts
- The Primal Hunt mechanic involves entering Mysterious Rifts, hunting a Rift Beast, and choosing a hatchling to spare to Evolve your Rift Beast’s Lineage. Afterward, complete Torn Rifts until the next Mysterious Rift becomes available.
- Interacting with this mechanic gives you Primordial Materials. You can exchange them with the Hunt Master NPC for general loot, Primordial Uniques, and Runes of Evolution. Rift Beasts can also drop all Primordial Uniques.
- You can first access Primal Hunts in the Campaign beginning at Area Level 20.
- You can find Primal Hunts in both Campaign and Monolith Echoes, except in Quest Echoes, Arena Echoes, or Echoes containing a Tomb or Cemetery.
- Three Woven Echoes include this mechanic, and four Weaver Tree nodes enhance it.
